$comment: Upstream ABI provenance pin (CC-50 round-4 MEDIUM-1). `check:abi-drift --strict` binds every must-verify ABI to a CLEAN, NAMED upstream revision: repos[].revision must match the sibling checkout's HEAD, that checkout must have no uncommitted changes, and each artifact must still hash-match the sources it records in its solc metadata. contracts[].abiSha256 pins the SDK's own vendored copy, so re-syncing an ABI without updating this file is a hard failure rather than a silent swap. Update it in the SAME commit that re-syncs an ABI.
